Dataset Summary
SWE-Skills-Bench is a benchmark dataset for evaluating whether injected skill documents — structured packages of procedural knowledge — measurably improve LLM agent performance on real-world software engineering tasks.
The dataset contains 49 skills spanning 565 task instances across six software engineering domains (Deployment & DevOps, Analytics & Monitoring, API Development, Data Science & ML, Security & Testing, and Developer Tools).
